beats.say: Solve seven to the power X minus one equals five to the power X minus three.
Seven and five cannot be made the same base. So take log on both sides.
Bring down the powers. Each power comes down in front of its log.

do.text: Bring down power: $\lg x^r = r\lg x$

beats.say: So X minus one, times log seven, equals X minus three, times log five.
Log seven and log five are just numbers. Expand the brackets as usual.
Put the X terms on the left, and the number terms on the right.
Factorise out X, then divide by log seven minus log five.
Press calculator. X is about minus eight point five seven.
The calculator shows minus eight point five six six five four. Rounding never removes a minus.
So X is about minus eight point five seven.
